title: Gemini four Argon one million tokens
style: neon dark, cyan accent, hype energetic

lines: Google just unveiled *Gemini four Argon*, and one number stands out.
Its output limit jumped from *sixty four thousand* tokens to *one million*.
That is hundreds of thousands of words, in a *single answer*.
Google says its agents rewrote *thirty two thousand* lines of a video decoder in Rust, and it runs *two point seven times* faster than the earlier Rust version.
It is rolling out in stages, starting with *cyber defenders*. Follow for more.

facts.claim: Output limit rose from 64,000 to 1,000,000 tokens
Google says the Rust rewrite runs 2.7 times faster than the earlier Rust version

post.title: Gemini four Argon: one million tokens in one answer
post.tiktok_caption: Google's new model jumped its output limit from 64,000 to 1,000,000 tokens. Here is why that matters. #Gemini #Google #AI #fyp
post.yt_caption: Google unveiled Gemini four Argon. The output limit just went from 64K to 1M tokens. Follow FredsDesk for daily AI news.
post.pinned_comment: The 2.7x speed-up is Google's own example (rewriting a video decoder in Rust) and is compared to the earlier Rust version, not the original C/C++ code. Rollout is staged, starting with trusted cyber defenders.

sources.name: T2 Online, Google launches Gemini four Argon for cyber defenders first
